## ✅ Workflow Acceptance Summary — AES-128 Encrypt-Only Full-System

**Conversation ID:** `39d6b054-db1e-4640-a1fd-950621976c0b`
**System Goal:** Autonomously design, implement, validate, repair, and integrate an AES-128 encrypt-only FPGA full-system using block-level handshake and an iterative 10-round microarchitecture.

---

### 🟢 Workflow Gate Decision: **SUCCESS** (terminal)

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Completion Status | `success` |
| Integration Status | `passed` |
| Integration Attempts | 1 |
| Promotion Failures | 0 |
| Blocked / Pending Modules | 0 / 0 |
| Protocol Violation | None |

---

### 🧩 All 4 Required Modules — Promoted & Validated

| Module | Validation Status | Checkpoints Passed |
|---|---|---|
| **aes_sbox** | ✅ PASSED | CHK_SBOX_MATCH (4 vectors passed) |
| **aes_key_schedule_128** | ✅ PASSED | CHK_ROUNDKEY_MATCH (known_answer_vectors) |
| **aes_round_transform** | ✅ PASSED | CHK_ROUND_STATE_MATCH (known_answer_vectors) |
| **aes128_encrypt_core** (primary sink) | ✅ PASSED | CHK_RESET_CLEAR, CHK_START_ACCEPTED, CHK_BUSY_ASSERTED, CHK_DONE_PULSE, CHK_CIPHERTEXT_MATCH, CHK_BUSY_DEASSERTED |

### 🔬 Integration Regression — All 3 Campaigns Passed

| Campaign | Scenario | Checkpoints |
|---|---|---|
| **baseline** | Normal encrypt operation | All 6/6 PASS |
| **back_to_back** | Consecutive encrypts | All 6/6 PASS |
| **mid_reset** | Reset-during-busy, reset-after-done | All 6/6 PASS |

**Total integration checkpoints: 18/18 PASS** (0 failed, 0 missing)

### 📁 Promoted Deliverables

- **RTL:** `aes128_encrypt_core.v`, `aes_key_schedule_128.v`, `aes_round_transform.v`, `aes_sbox.v`, `aes_sbox_lut.vh`
- **Testbenches:** `aes128_encrypt_core_tb.cpp`, `aes_key_schedule_128_tb.cpp`, `aes_round_transform_tb.cpp`, `aes_sbox_tb.cpp`, `aes_tb_common.hpp`
- **Interface freeze hash:** `aes-128-block_handshake-iterative_10_round-autonomous-v1`
- **Latency target:** 11 cycles

---

**Outcome:** The AES-128 encrypt-only FPGA full-system with block-level handshake and iterative 10-round microarchitecture was successfully designed, validated, repaired (0 failures), promoted (4/4 modules), and integration-tested across all required regression campaigns with zero checkpoint failures.
